mr_title: Improving ux for search in webviews on web

expected_issues.title: Selection collapsed on every find request, so 'next' never advances
expected_issues.description:
The selection is collapsed to its anchor before every find request, including 'find next', so window.find() restarts from the beginning of the current match and keeps selecting the same occurrence.

Collapsing the selection is only needed when the search term changes (so refining 'a' to 'ab' re-checks the current position). For repeated next/previous requests with the same term, collapsing to the anchor makes the search start before the current result, which is found again: 'Find next' in webviews never advances. The collapse must be conditional on a changed search value.
